description: Human 4on4 dm3 state-distribution corpus (per-tick position/velocity/view + inverse-dynamics-recovered actions, all held out). Lightweight provenance/stats record only — the ~125 GB database is NOT committed.

parser.note: schema-33 is REQUIRED — the schema-21 selection binary silently drops per-tick view-yaw and would corrupt strafe-sign recovery

etl.producer: scratch PHASE4-STREAM patch (per-demo streaming insert + bounded worker window); the reviewed, tested port is merged as PR #383 (commit c7c09e6)

errors.error: pos stream missing ['vya','vp','vx','vy','vz'] — not a schema-33 positions,view,velocity export; correctly skipped + logged, not silently dropped

etl.split_policy: group_by_demo_sha256_bucket (u = int(sha256_hex[:8],16)/0xFFFFFFFF; train u<0.70, val u<0.85, else test)
etl.onground_note: geometric pmove_sim floor-trace proxy (player_ticks.onground_is_proxy=1), a distinct measurement plane from a live KTX on-ground flag

verify.tool: run_verify.py (servexeri, in-place over the 125 GB DB)
verify.result: GREEN — referential integrity clean, on-ground populated both states, every recovered action row held out (0 trainable idm rows)

hold_out: every actions row carries label_source='idm' and is_interp=1 — this is a STATE distribution, not a label set; no recovered action trains until per-head weights unlock the trustworthy heads

reproducibility.values_and_splits: reproducible from merged ETL PR #383 (c7c09e6): the scratch patch and #383 use the identical sha-bucket split thresholds and identical state/action values
reproducibility.demo_id: this corpus carries autoincrement-by-completion-order demo_ids (scratch patch); #383 assigns content-stable sha-rank demo_ids, so a re-extraction under #383 yields identical values + splits but renumbered demo_ids
reproducibility.re_extraction: a fully #383-reproducible re-extraction (deterministic demo_ids) is deferred until RL is greenlit; immaterial for the held-out-action state-prior use

use: RL state prior + reward/cadence anchor (plans/rl-plan.md STEP 0); action labels held out; forwardmove never used
what_this_does_not_prove: Green verification proves referential integrity, that geometric on-ground populated both states, and that every recovered action is held out. It does NOT prove the inverse-dynamics-recovered labels are correct, that the corpus yields useful movement behavior, that a full re-extraction stays within memory under #383, or that any bot improved.
